pages.text: The $(item)Experience Syringe$() is a portable XP battery. It stores up to $(bold)1,600 XP points$() (32 buckets) and lets you bank and restore experience without wasting a drop.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: $(bold)Right-click$() (empty hand) — withdraws exactly the XP needed to bring you to your next level.$(br2)$(bold)Sneak + right-click$() — deposits your current level-progress XP into the syringe. If you are standing at a precise level boundary, the full previous level's worth of XP is deposited instead.$(br2)Both actions play the experience orb pickup sound. The item bar on the syringe turns neon green as it fills.

pages.title: Capacity
pages.text: The syringe holds a maximum of $(bold)1,600 XP points$(). The item tooltip shows current fill as both mB and XP points (50 XP = 1,000 mB).$(br2)There is no upgrade path — one syringe is enough to capture a player's level progression without waste.
